changeinfo.changes: - Added connectivity for Resident Evil.Net. - Fixed various issues and improved stabilty.
- Added online co-op for Raid Mode. - Makes Resident Evil.Net events playable. - Fixed various issues and improved stabilty.

- Added Lottie costume for Raid mode character Cipher. - Added Rachael and Lady Hunk costumes for Raid mode character Gina. - Added costume for Raid mode character Pedro. In order to use this costume, you must first unlock Cipher, Gina, and Pedro. - When you obtain an item in Raid mode, the item will now pop up on the right hand side of the screen. - Increased the pop-up animation speed for items that pop up on the screen when you obtain them in Raid mode and when they are displayed on the result screen. - Made the game more stable by fixing issues that were present in Raid mode co-op play. - Made the game more stable by fixing issues that occurred alongside communication errors.

- Added White Lottie costume for Raid mode character Cipher. - Added Jessica costume for Raid mode character Gina. In order to use these costumes, you must first unlock Cipher and Gina. - Fixed issues for Barry's campaign related to his initially equipped weapons and the EX weapons you earn. - Fixed various issues and improved stability.
